instruction: Send a phone text message to my partner, "The dishwasher is clean and ready to be emptied.".
notes: Single-app task (phone) plus supervisor. The partner's phone number is unknown initially and is discovered via phone.search_contacts filtered by relationship='partner'; static init facts (has-relationship, has-phone-number) encode that the partner contact exists without revealing the number, and known-phone-number gates send_text_message. The goal demands exactly one text message to the partner with the given text (matching the evaluation's added GlobalTextMessage/UserTextMessage records). supervisor-complete-task carries the person/message as non-API record parameters so its precondition equals the goal condition; no answer is passed since the task is not a question. Reference solution has 6 calls (likely an extra phone.show_contact_relationships or supervisor.show_profile); the minimal plan here uses 5.
